attempts.response:
```sql
WITH vaccination_nfhs4 AS (
    SELECT "District", "Children age 12-23 months fully vaccinated (%)" AS vaccination_nfhs4
    FROM "district_health_factsheet"
    WHERE "State" = 'Bihar' AND "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-4'
),
vaccination_nfhs5 AS (
    SELECT "District", "Children age 12-23 months fully vaccinated (%)" AS vaccination_nfhs5
    FROM "district_health_factsheet"
    WHERE "State" = 'Bihar' AND "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-5'
)
SELECT 
    v5."District",
    (v5.vaccination_nfhs5 - v4.vaccination_nfhs4) AS vaccination_change_percentage_points
FROM 
    vaccination_nfhs5 v5
JOIN 
    vaccination_nfhs4 v4 ON v5."District" = v4."District";
```
